This association suggests that individuals with lower serum chloride levels may be at a higher risk of cardiovascular events, which can ultimately lead to increased mortality rates. Therefore, healthcare professionals should closely monitor patients with low serum chloride levels and consider interventions to address any underlying conditions contributing to the low serum chloride level.
